invariants.rationale: The method always returns a merged JsonValue, so result should never be null under normal operation.
The method merges mapElement with the template, so result is a new object, not simply mapElement.
mergeParentElementWithTemplate is expected to return a merged object, which should be a JSON object node.
mapElement is the parent element being merged and is accessed (e.g., mapElement.getString()), therefore it must not be null at method exit.
If mapElement had 'properties', these should still be present or merged in result.
